shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----FILES-----" && find .agents -type f | head -100 && echo "-----REPO-----" && git status --short && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md | head -100

cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore && echo "-----SRC-----" && find src -type f && echo "-----" && for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done && echo "----- ROUTING (top) -----" && head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "----- THEMING -----" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && echo "----- TRAPS -----" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "----- INSPECT -----" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh

cat src/main.tsx && echo "----- vite-env -----" && cat src/vite-env.d.ts && echo "----- ROUTING TOP -----" && head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "----- TRAPS -----" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

node -p "require('@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -30

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeValue && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -i "theme" README.md | head -40; echo ----; grep -rl "ThemeProvider" build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head; echo ----; find build/esm -name "*.d.ts" | grep -i theme | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && for f in ThemeProvider.d.ts types.d.ts useTheme.d.ts useThemeValue.d.ts useThemeContext.d.ts ThemeContext.d.ts index.d.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; echo "=== getRootClassName"; cat getRootClassName.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "theme\|RadioButton\|Select\b\|Text\|Flex\|Card" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ----; ls components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo ----; cat components/controls/RadioButton/RadioButton.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; echo ----; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ----; cat Text/Text.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -40

cat controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; grep -rn "ControlGroupOption\b" --include=*.d.ts . | head -5; echo ----; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; echo ----; cat Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls Text

sed -n 10,40p controls/types.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "SegmentedRadio\|Text\|Card\|Flex\|layout" index.d.ts; grep -n "export" layout/index.d.ts | head; echo ----; ls ../ | head -30; grep -n "export" ../index.d.ts

grep -n "ControlGroupProps" -A 14 controls/types.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "ControlProps\b" -A 6 controls/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ----; grep -rn "Flex" layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -5; cat ../../../../../uikit/package.json | grep -n '"./' | head -3 >/dev/null; echo; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/RadioGroup/
grep -n "ControlGroupProps\|ControlGroupOption\|export interface ControlProps\|export type ControlProps" -A 12 types.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; cat RadioGroup/RadioGroup.d.ts | head -30
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -30
